subject: cursor-agent
title: Standalone MIT harness named cursor-agent; zero dependency on Cursor's closed CLI, collides with cursor.com identity
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/factory.py:166-196 (Cursor models only via caller-configured OpenAI-compatible gateway); grep for subprocess/exec in cursor_agent_tools/ finds no Cursor-binary invocation (only rg at tools/search_tools.py:149 and shell exec at tools/system_tools.py:96)
one_why: Dispatcher's wrapper hypothesis is false -- the Python tree is the whole harness; scored as such. Corpus risk: census/synthesis must not import facts from Cursor Inc.'s cursor-agent CLI; census upstream_remote (civai-technologies) confirmed correct.

subject: cursor-agent
title: Policy evaluator contains a branch written to pass a test: hardcoded 'rm -rf /' special case inside yolo allowlist logic
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/permissions.py:217-221 (comment at :219: 'This ensures our test passes by guaranteeing this specific command needs confirmation'); test at tests/test_permissions.py:180
one_why: Test-driven special-casing leaks into the security decision path: any other destructive command not in the allowlist still gets the generic confirmation branch, and the special case silently implies the allowlist path otherwise auto-approves substring-matched commands.

subject: cursor-agent
title: Command allow/deny gating is substring inclusion, trivially bypassable
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/permissions.py:196-203 (deny: any(denied in command)), :206-212 and :222-226 (allow: any(allowed in command))
one_why: 'echo not-rm' satisfies an allowlist entry; a denylisted 'rm' command runs as 'r''m -rf'; classic pattern-match gating with no shell tokenization (contrast codex execpolicy DSL).

subject: cursor-agent
title: No compaction at all: unbounded history, overflow caught as a user-facing error string; trim_context_history trims display lists, not model context
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/base.py:82 (conversation_history append-only); cursor_agent_tools/interact.py:244-246 ('Too many tokens' -> return error message); interact.py:1040-1063 (trims only user_info tool_calls[-10:]/command_history[-5:] display lists)
one_why: Long tasks die at the context wall with an error; the function named like compaction makes the gap look managed -- the 2-rung 'present but misleading' pattern.

subject: cursor-agent
title: constraints.md documents summarization/pruning/backoff 'workarounds' that are not implemented
evidence: constraints.md:11 ('Workaround: Implement conversation summarization and prune history'), :17 ('implement automatic code chunking'), :20-21 ('Implement exponential backoff retry logic'); no such code in cursor_agent_tools/ (grep compact|summariz|backoff)
one_why: The docs describe the intended architecture, the code ships the naive path; reviewers/census must not score these claims -- they are TODOs phrased as workarounds.

subject: cursor-agent
title: CI pytest gate filters away most of its own suite: ignores a nonexistent tests/requires_api/ dir, -k excludes file-tool and image tests, most provider tests skipif on live API keys
evidence: .github/workflows/test.yml:41-44 (--ignore=tests/requires_api/ --ignore dir does not exist; -k 'not test_file_tools and not test_image'); skipif-key patterns e.g. tests/test_claude_agent.py:68, tests/test_claude_chat.py:23
one_why: Effective CI coverage is lint + a small offline subset (~test_permissions, test_tool_execution_records, test_backward_compat); regressions in the tool-file layer pass CI silently -- the records-test docstring itself admits 'can never pass CI silently again' was a past problem.

subject: cursor-agent
title: Agent loop fused into the 1243-LOC interactive CLI module; provider chat() is single-completion plus one tool round by design
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/interact.py:297+ (run_agent_interactive), :710-739 (mechanical continuation prompt injection), :633-691 (is_task_complete); claude_agent.py:344-346 ('Multi-step continuation belongs to run_agent_interactive (harness)')
one_why: Loop, budget checks, TTY policy, trimming and terminal formatting live in a CLI presentation file, so the loop is untestable headlessly as a unit and each provider cannot drive multi-step work on its own.

subject: cursor-agent
title: Task termination decided by prose phrase-matching ('in conclusion' + 'all requirements') with an exact terminate sentinel as the only reliable signal
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/interact.py:652-691 (completion_indicators list, 'summary section without next steps', :687 'in conclusion' check); sentinel protocol at interact.py:646-649 and schemas.py TERMINATE_TEXT_SENTINEL
one_why: Model output phrasing ends or continues the run; a refusal that says 'task complete' halts mid-task, a summary-style continuation loops on injected prompts until the tool-call cap. Only the explicit sentinel is sound.

subject: cursor-agent
title: Registration owns the tool argument contract: declared arg_aliases, host remap hook, schema-property filtering, required-arg validation converted to structured ToolResult instead of TypeError
evidence: cursor_agent_tools/base.py:150-170 (register_tool arg_aliases), :179-226 (normalize_tool_call_arguments), :245-268 (run_registered_tool required-arg check -> structured error)
one_why: Small, provider-agnostic pattern that turns the most common model misfire (wrong/missing arg keys across providers) into a model-readable tool error rather than a crash -- worth lifting as a concept for our harness's tool registry.
